args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

The file src/components/Toast.tsx shows that toasts have a fixed dismissal time of five seconds (AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 5000) for all kinds, including errors, and the aria-live attribute is hard-coded as polite for the whole toast stack, causing the delay in screen reader announcements. This explains the issue that error toasts are not announced immediately and vanish too quickly.
